fuel_consumption.source_quote: Fuel consumption not stated explicitly in gallons; item7a notes ~11% of 2004 fuel requirements hedged (39% of Q1 2004).

instrument_type_details.notes: Costless collar agreements on heating oil. ~11% of 2004 full-year fuel requirements hedged; 39% of Q1 2004 hedged. Net fair value = $21.2M (asset) at Dec 31, 2003 vs. $3.6M at Dec 31, 2002. Large increase in fair value due to rising oil prices in 2003.

warnings: Net fair value increased significantly from $3.6M (Dec 31, 2002) to $21.2M (Dec 31, 2003) due to rising fuel prices.
Only 11% of full-year 2004 requirements hedged (front-loaded: 39% of Q1 2004).
